_doc: Drive 9 round 2 face spec (d9_post.py, merged over art/rosace/faces/wh2.json + finish_f2/faces_f2.json 'eyes_big'). One face spec for idle and back (the critique: 'lock one face spec for all idle and back frames'). Same stamp grammar as wh2.json (authored for a face turned toward +x: the near eye on the left with its outer corner at the left end; mirrored for -x). Legend: '.' keep, O lash (OL), a iris dark (A2), c iris mid (A3), d iris light crescent (A4), w catchlight (A5), W eye white (W2), K pupil / iris top rim (I4, the darkest hair tone), k lash taper (I3), m soft hair tone (I2: brows), 1-4 skin S1-S4, b blush. The critique's face fixes, as drawn here: a 4-tone iris (K top rim under the lid, a, c, d crescent) with a 2 px catchlight and a 1 px secondary; the upper lash tapers (two rows at the outer corner, one row, then the k taper at the inner end) and lifts at the outer corner (the flick goes up, not down); the lower lash is 1-2 px of S4 (a mid tone, never black); the lid sits one row over the iris top (knowing, not sleepy); a 4 px closed smile with the camera-side corner lifted (144) and 3 px (80); arched brows in a soft hair tone drawn only where the fringe leaves skin.
